notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix: Trade Castle Reward Calculation Issue
notes.notes:
🔧 Hotfix: Trade Castle Reward Calculation Issue Resolved
[hr][/hr]
We've addressed an issue where the Trade Castle popup was displaying or granting an incorrect amount of coins. With this hotfix:

The reward is now correctly calculated based on the exact amount of coins available at the time the quest is sent, ensuring consistency and fairness.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support!
-Special Thanks  @XpiRai for reporting this issue

notes.title: 🐟 Fisher Idle - Quality & Comfort Update 🎯
notes.notes:
Hello fishermen! 🚢🎣  
I'm back with a fresh update filled with useful improvements and exciting new features to enhance your fishing journey!  
Let’s dive into what’s new! 🐠  

[hr][/hr]  

🆕 What's New?  
  
 🎣 Your Mouse is Now a Fish!  
The classic pointer has been replaced with a fish-shaped cursor to better match the game’s oceanic theme. A small touch that fits the vibe perfectly.  

 🛍️ Auto Click Shop Has Arrived!  
We’ve introduced a dedicated auto clicker shop for all you idle masters.  
     🌀 Includes a brand-new Auto Click Bar so you can visually track your click timing.  
     🎮 The old "just-click-a-button" mechanic has been reworked to better fit the idle theme based on your suggestions. Now it’s more fun and functional.  

 💬 Tooltips are Here!  
Ever been confused by a button or feature? Now, with the new tooltip system, you'll get helpful hints and explanations while hovering.  

 🧼 Visual Cleanup & Optimization  
Unnecessary visual elements and lighting settings have been cleaned up. General performance improvements have been made to keep things smooth.  

 ⏩ Hold-to-Buy System Added  
You can now hold your mouse on any upgrade button to buy repeatedly. Quick and easy, no more clicking over and over.  
  

[hr][/hr]  

🔮 What’s Next?  
Here's a preview of what's currently in development  

  
 🎣 A brand-new fishing mini-game  
 📊 A progress bar above fishing characters showing catch timing  
 🏪 Reworking the Fishing Shop to be more useful and closer to an auction-style system  
  

[hr][/hr]  

🧠 Developer Notes  

  
 💸 I'm actively working on economic balance. A major update is on the way to improve scaling and idle-friendly pacing.  
 ⚙️ A full optimization pass is coming, including more performance settings for smoother gameplay.  
  

[hr][/hr]  

Thanks for playing Fisher Idle and being part of this growing fishing adventure.  
If you have feedback or suggestions, leave a comment. I read them all. 👀  
And yes, more updates are on the way 😉  

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: 🐟 Fisher Idle - Update Notes 🌊
notes.notes:
Hey there, fishermen! 🚢🎣

The first update for Fisher Idle has arrived! 🎉 I've made several fixes and improvements to make your fishing journey smoother and more enjoyable. Plus, I’ve been working on some exciting upcoming features that will be part of future updates! 🚀

This patch brings UI, sound, graphics, and readability improvements, along with preparations for some major new content coming soon. Let’s dive into the details! ⬇️

[hr][/hr]

⚙ Bug Fixes & Improvements 🛠


 UI Windows No Longer Overlap!

Fixed an issue where UI windows would stack on top of each other when opening and closing menus.
 Fixed Camera Zoom While UI is Open! 🔍

You can now Zoom In & Zoom Out without any issues while the UI is open.
 Graphics Settings Now Save Properly! 🎨

Fixed an issue where Ultra settings would reset randomly.
Your graphics settings will now stay saved permanently after changes.
 Sound Settings Now Save Correctly! 🔊

Volume settings are now saved properly, and slider values will load correctly when you restart the game.
 Game & Menu Sounds are Now Synchronized! 🎵

Fixed the issue where menu and in-game sounds had separate volume controls, causing inconsistency.
Now they work seamlessly together for a better audio experience.
 Translation Errors Fixed! 📜

Corrected various localization issues for a better gameplay experience.
 Ship Income Display is Now More Readable! 🚢

Improved the visibility of the income text on ships.
Also fixed an issue where the text overlapped with other UI elements.

[hr][/hr]

✨ New Features & Future Update Preparations 🚀


 Achievements System Preparation! 🏆

The foundation for an Achievements System has been implemented!
Expect achievements to arrive in the next major update.
 "Early Access Note" Added to Main Menu! 📌

A reminder has been added to the Main Menu, indicating that the game is still in Early Access.
 New "Save" Button in Settings! 💾

You can now manually save your settings with a dedicated Save button in the Settings Menu.
 Ship Income Text Color Changed! 🟢

The income display on ships is now green, making it much easier to read.
 More Readable Ship Income Format! ⏳

Ship earnings are now displayed in XX.XX format, making them much clearer.
 New Castle Trade Area Added! 🏰

The Castle Trade Area has been added to the game!
This will become an interactive trading hub in a future major update!

[hr][/hr]

💙 Thanks for Your Support! 🎣

This is only the first update, and there’s much more to come! 🚀

If you have any feedback or encounter a bug, feel free to let me know! Your support and suggestions help shape the game’s future!

[hr][/hr]
